decision.observed_event: Turn order: you, the fourth player, the dealer, the door-side player, the fresco-side player. You hold your ground and wait for them to come to you. The fourth player swings at you and misses every time. The dealer hits you once: 5 piercing damage. The door-side player attacks and misses. The fresco-side player hits you: 4 slashing damage. Your turn.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren waits for them to attack first.
improv_read.connection: The crew wants the coins back and attacks together.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit plays the round in order so the player sees who hit and who missed.

public_brief.objective: Wear her down and get the coins back.
public_brief.tactic: Hit her together and demand she empty her coat.
public_brief.visible_cue: The sap and the dealer's blade both find her; two others miss.
public_brief.player_opening: It is her turn to act.
public_brief.reply_to: I've got my rapier out and wait for them to make the first move.
public_brief.kit_focus: Show each of the four attacks in order, two hits and two misses, then hand her the turn.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: crisp blow-by-blow, then her turn

player_mood.cue: wait for them to make the first move

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Wren holds her ground, rapier point low, and lets them come. The fourth player swings a weighted sap and catches only air. The dealer slides in behind and his knife point finds her side. The door-side player lunges wide. The fresco-side player's knife nicks her forearm.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: There, you see? The dead are patient, but when they strike, they strike together. Empty your coat, little thief, and perhaps we will leave you enough blood to walk home on.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: You take five piercing and four slashing, nine in all. Your turn.
